#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Explicit opt-in proof against real Course and Student HTTP owners.

Fixtures must already be seeded in disposable proof databases. No service is
started and no database reset is performed. Practice's companion integration
suite consumes the exported exact assignment correlation, then this script's
verify phase checks its authoritative delivered result.
"""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import uuid


def request(base, method, route, payload=None, headers=None, expected=(200, 201)):
    raw = None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(base + route, data=raw, method=method,
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", **(headers or {})})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as response:
            status, body = response.status, response.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        status, body = error.code, error.read()
    if status not in expected:
        raise AssertionError(f"{method} {route}: status {status}, expected {expected}; {body.decode()}")
    return json.loads(body) if body and status < 400 else None


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("phase", choices=("prepare", "quiz", "verify"))
    p.add_argument("--course-url", default="http://127.0.0.1:18090")
    p.add_argument("--student-url", default="http://127.0.0.1:18091")
    p.add_argument("--course-token", default="proof-course")
    p.add_argument("--planner-token", default="proof-planner")
    p.add_argument("--lesson-id")
    p.add_argument("--course-id")
    p.add_argument("--quiz-id")
    p.add_argument("--practice-revision", default="00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003")
    p.add_argument("--fixture", default="/private/tmp/lesson-completion-practice-fixture.json")
    args = p.parse_args()
    for url in (args.course_url, args.student_url):
        assert urllib.parse.urlsplit(url).hostname in ("127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"), "proof owners must be loopback"
    if args.phase == "quiz":
        fixture = json.loads(Path(args.fixture).read_text())
        assert fixture.get("quiz_id"), "quiz phase requires prepare --quiz-id"
        headers = {"X-User-ID": fixture["student_id"], "X-User-Role": "STUDENT"}
        current = request(args.course_url, "POST", "/internal/lessons/" + fixture["lesson_id"] + "/revision",
                          headers={"X-Internal-Token": args.course_token})
        quiz = next(t for t in current["content"]["tasks"] if t["id"] == fixture["quiz_id"])
        question = next(q for q in quiz["tests"] if q["id"] == fixture["quiz_question_id"])
        assert next(v["id"] for v in question["variants"] if v.get("is_correct")) != fixture["quiz_correct_id"], "root must change Course current answer key before quiz phase"
        start_route = "/api/v1/student/tasks/" + fixture["quiz_id"] + "/start"
        binding = {"learning_path_item_id": fixture["learning_path_item_id"], "requirement_id": fixture["quiz_requirement_id"]}
        failed = request(args.student_url, "POST", start_route, binding, headers)
        submit_route = "/api/v1/student/tasks/" + fixture["quiz_id"] + "/answers/" + failed["answer_id"] + "/submit"
        result = request(args.student_url, "POST", submit_route, {"answer_payload": {"answers": [{"test_id": fixture["quiz_question_id"], "variant_id": fixture["quiz_wrong_id"]}]}}, headers)
        assert result["status"] == "FAILED", result
        path_route = "/api/v1/student/learning-paths/" + fixture["learning_path_id"]
        failed_path = request(args.student_url, "GET", path_route, headers=headers)
        assert not next(r for r in failed_path["items"][0]["frozen_requirements"] if r["requirement_id"] == fixture["quiz_requirement_id"])["satisfied"]
        passed = request(args.student_url, "POST", start_route, binding, headers)
        assert passed["learning_action_id"] != failed["learning_action_id"], "failed retry did not open a new learning action"
        submit_route = "/api/v1/student/tasks/" + fixture["quiz_id"] + "/answers/" + passed["answer_id"] + "/submit"
        payload = {"answer_payload": {"answers": [{"test_id": fixture["quiz_question_id"], "variant_id": fixture["quiz_correct_id"]}]}}
        result = request(args.student_url, "POST", submit_route, payload, headers)
        assert result["status"] == "PASSED", result
        completed = request(args.student_url, "GET", path_route, headers=headers)
        assert next(r for r in completed["items"][0]["frozen_requirements"] if r["requirement_id"] == fixture["quiz_requirement_id"])["satisfied"]
        assert not any(r["satisfied"] for r in completed["items"][1]["frozen_requirements"])
        print(json.dumps({"status": "PASS", "proof": "official failed attempt then passed retry used frozen R10 key after current Course key changed"}))
        return
    if args.phase == "verify":
        fixture = json.loads(Path(args.fixture).read_text())
        headers = {"X-User-ID": fixture["student_id"], "X-User-Role": "STUDENT"}
        path = request(args.student_url, "GET", "/api/v1/student/learning-paths/" + fixture["learning_path_id"], headers=headers)
        first, second = path["items"][:2]
        practice = next(r for r in first["frozen_requirements"] if r["type"] == "practice_completed")
        assert practice["requirement_id"] == fixture["requirement_id"] and practice["satisfied"]
        assert not any(r["satisfied"] for r in second["frozen_requirements"]), "Practice completion affected repeated assignment"
        assert first["status"] == "COMPLETED", "all required facts did not complete exact item"
        assert second["status"] != "COMPLETED"
        print(json.dumps({"status": "PASS", "proof": "authoritative Practice delivery satisfied exact frozen requirement only", "item_id": first["learning_path_item_id"]}))
        return
    assert args.lesson_id and args.course_id, "prepare requires --lesson-id and --course-id from isolated Course seed"
    student_id, plan_id = str(uuid.uuid4()), str(uuid.uuid4())
    theory_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    activities = [
        {"activity_id": theory_id, "type": "theory_acknowledged", "required": True,
         "source_reference": {"id": args.lesson_id}},
        {"activity_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "type": "practice_completed", "required": True,
         "source_reference": {"id": args.practice_revision, "revision_id": args.practice_revision}},
    ]
    if args.quiz_id:
        activities.append({"activity_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "type": "quiz_passed", "required": True,
                           "source_reference": {"id": args.quiz_id}})
    admin = {"X-User-ID": str(uuid.uuid4()), "X-User-Role": "ADMIN"}
    private = {"X-Internal-Token": args.course_token}
    policy_route = "/admin/v1/lesson/" + args.lesson_id + "/completion-policy"
    request(args.course_url, "PUT", policy_route, {"activities": activities}, admin, (200, 204))
    r10 = request(args.course_url, "POST", "/internal/lessons/" + args.lesson_id + "/revision", headers=private)
    revision_id = r10["lesson_revision_id"]
    headers = {"X-User-ID": student_id, "X-User-Role": "STUDENT"}
    payload = {"planning_request_id": plan_id, "course_id": args.course_id, "goal_code": "go.backend",
               "curriculum_revision": "completion-proof-r10", "planner_policy_version": "course-planner-v1",
               "reason_code": "initial_plan", "reason_summary": "isolated lesson completion proof", "expected_version": 0,
               "items": [{"reference_type": "lesson", "reference_id": args.lesson_id,
                          "lesson_revision_id": revision_id, "position": i,
                          "status": "READY" if i == 0 else "PLANNED", "targets": [{"type": "concept", "key": "loops", "version": "v1"}],
                          "reason_code": "first_current_gap"} for i in range(2)]}
    planner = {"X-Internal-Token": args.planner_token, "Idempotency-Key": plan_id}
    route = "/internal/students/" + student_id + "/learning-path"
    path = request(args.student_url, "PUT", route, payload, planner)
    first, second = path["items"]
    assert first["lesson_revision_id"] == second["lesson_revision_id"] == revision_id
    assert first["learning_path_item_id"] != second["learning_path_item_id"]
    assert {r["requirement_id"] for r in first["frozen_requirements"]}.isdisjoint({r["requirement_id"] for r in second["frozen_requirements"]})
    content_route = "/api/v1/student/learning-path-items/" + first["learning_path_item_id"] + "/content"
    old_content = request(args.student_url, "GET", content_route, headers=headers)
    def safe_public(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            assert not ({"is_correct", "correct_order", "expected_answers", "reference_solution", "private_suite_ref", "verifier_artifacts"} & set(value)), "private assessment keys leaked in public frozen content"
            for variant in value.get("variants", []):
                assert not ({"group_id", "group_source_key"} & set(variant)), "private classification scoring key leaked"
            for child in value.values():
                safe_public(child)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            for child in value:
                safe_public(child)
    safe_public(old_content)
    r11_activities = activities + [{"activity_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "type": "theory_acknowledged", "required": True,
                                    "source_reference": {"id": args.lesson_id}}]
    request(args.course_url, "PUT", policy_route, {"activities": r11_activities}, admin, (200, 204))
    r11 = request(args.course_url, "POST", "/internal/lessons/" + args.lesson_id + "/revision", headers=private)
    assert r11["lesson_revision_id"] != revision_id
    assert request(args.course_url, "GET", "/internal/lesson-revisions/" + revision_id, headers=private) == r10
    assert request(args.student_url, "GET", content_route, headers=headers) == old_content
    assert request(args.student_url, "PUT", route, payload, planner)["items"] == path["items"]
    theory = next(r for r in first["frozen_requirements"] if r["type"] == "theory_acknowledged")
    ack_route = "/api/v1/student/learning-path-items/" + first["learning_path_item_id"] + "/theory-acknowledgements"
    ack_headers = {**headers, "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())}
    acknowledged = request(args.student_url, "POST", ack_route, {"requirement_id": theory["requirement_id"]}, ack_headers)
    assert acknowledged["status"] != "COMPLETED", "theory alone completed required practice"
    assert request(args.student_url, "POST", ack_route, {"requirement_id": theory["requirement_id"]}, ack_headers) == acknowledged
    practice = next(r for r in first["frozen_requirements"] if r["type"] == "practice_completed")
    request(args.student_url, "POST", ack_route, {"requirement_id": practice["requirement_id"]},
            {**headers, "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())}, (409,))
    refreshed = request(args.student_url, "GET", "/api/v1/student/learning-paths/" + path["id"], headers=headers)
    assert not any(r["satisfied"] for r in refreshed["items"][1]["frozen_requirements"])
    fixture = {"student_id": student_id, "learning_path_id": path["id"],
               "learning_path_item_id": first["learning_path_item_id"], "requirement_id": practice["requirement_id"],
               "task_revision_id": args.practice_revision, "second_item_id": second["learning_path_item_id"],
               "lesson_revision_id": revision_id, "r11_revision_id": r11["lesson_revision_id"], "lesson_id": args.lesson_id, "quiz_id": args.quiz_id}
    if args.quiz_id:
        quiz = next(t for t in r10["content"]["tasks"] if t["id"] == args.quiz_id)
        assert len(quiz["tests"]) == 1, "smoke fixture requires one single choice question"
        question = quiz["tests"][0]
        fixture.update(quiz_question_id=question["id"],
                       quiz_correct_id=next(v["id"] for v in question["variants"] if v.get("is_correct")),
                       quiz_wrong_id=next(v["id"] for v in question["variants"] if not v.get("is_correct")),
                       quiz_requirement_id=next(r["requirement_id"] for r in first["frozen_requirements"] if r["type"] == "quiz_passed"))
    Path(args.fixture).write_text(json.dumps(fixture, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"status": "PASS", "proof": "Course R10/R11 HTTP immutable revisions, exact Student assignments, theory acknowledgment + replay + reject mismatch", "fixture": args.fixture}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
